copy.heading: Signs you are listening
copy.instructions: Tick each sign you showed at least once this week. Lauren will confirm.

items: You asked a question and waited for the whole answer.
You remembered something someone told you yesterday.
Your phone was face down, and it stayed face down when the group chat went off.
You did not glance at your watch to check your resting heart rate.
You said "that sounds hard" without adding "a bit like my knee".
You learned something new about Lauren's work, such as the name of her boss.
Your hand did not practise a backhand under the table.
